simple.meaning: כָּפָה (kâphâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to bend , i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: כָּפָה (kâphâh) / H3711 is traced through Proverbs 21:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: properly, to bend , i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue
definitions.full: H3711. kaphah [ כָּפָה ] verb probably subdue (Late Hebrew overturn, hold under, compel ; Aramaic כְּפָא , id. ; incline (as face to ground), overturn ; Assyrian kipû perhaps id. , Dl HWB 346 ; compare Arabic overturn, turn back ); — only Qal Imperfect יִכְמֶּהאָֿ֑ף בַּסֵּתֶר מַתָּן Prov 21:14 a gift in secret subdueth anger (so Thes Rob-Ges; Ew beugt: Fl De averteth , from the Arabic, is more remote; ᵐ5 ἀνατρέπει, compare Late Hebrew). כִּמָּה see below כפף .

occurrences.englishText: A gift in secret pacifies anger,
